nodes.label: EncodeToBase62
nodes.rationale: Treats input bytes as a big-endian big.Int and repeatedly div-mods by 62 to produce a URL-safe short code; used to turn URL bytes into the short key.

nodes.label: DeclareQueue
nodes.rationale: Declares a durable direct exchange bound to a quorum queue for at-least-once, HA delivery of url.created events.

nodes.label: ShortenURL handler
nodes.rationale: Encodes URL to base62, wraps it in ShortenerQueueBody with a new UUID and the authenticated userID, then publishes to RabbitMQ instead of writing the DB synchronously (async write-behind).

nodes.label: URL Shortener DB Worker (stub)
nodes.rationale: Intended RabbitMQ consumer for url.created that persists ShortenerQueueBody into ShortURLDB; file is currently an empty package stub (not implemented).
